reviews.title: I love the app But….
reviews.review: I love the app but I do have some complaints. I’ve been a yearly plan holder for quite some time now. The templates need to be longer or at least allow us to make them longer. If we can post up to a minute or more on most social media platforms why are you only allowing us 6-8 second templates. The max I’ve seen is maybe :15 but that is rare. reviews.title: Overall good app that could use a few improvements
reviews.review: I think Mojo is a good app and I use it regularly. Here are some suggestions for upgrades that would make it a great app… 1) Provide folders or a better way of organizing project posts. If you post often and use your previous projects as your own template, scrolling down through dozens of projects to find one can be time consuming. reviews.title: Coined response for common issues
reviews.review: It’s an app - many out there that do the same stuff.  If you get too fancy the app will crash esp with using company imported Logos and support knows this and uses coined responses and reasoning for it.  I don’t have time to capture all the data and send to them to fix myself yet they want me to do their work for them.  80 percent of the time the app works fine but with a few issues like when you move everything to Instagram the size of everything is blown up and half your images are now unseen.
